User Story: As a customer, I want to browse grocery categories so that I can find products by type.
As a customer, I want to search products by name so that I can quickly find an item.
As a customer, I want to view a product's price, size, and availability so that I can decide whether to add it to my basket.
As a customer, I want to filter search results by brand and price range so that I can narrow my choices.
As a customer, I want to add an available product to my cart so that I can collect items before checkout.
As a customer, I want to change an item's quantity in my cart so that my order reflects the amount I need.
As a customer, I want to see the cart subtotal and delivery charge so that I understand the expected cost before placing an order.
As a customer, I want to confirm my address and place my order so that the supermarket can prepare my groceries.
As a customer, I want to choose an available delivery slot so that my order arrives at a convenient time.
As a customer, I want an order confirmation with an order number so that I know my order was received.
As a customer, I want to see whether my order is being prepared, dispatched, or delivered so that I know its progress.
As a customer, I want a notification when my order is out for delivery so that I can be ready to receive it.
